subject: Q3 QBR prep: compact runway notes + account-by-account asks
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 QBR prep: compact runway notes + account-by-account asks

Team —

We need a compact, exec-ready pack for the QBR next Thurs. I want a single-slide summary per named account (one paragraph + 2 bullets: risk & ask), and a consolidated forecast grid that rolls up committed vs best-case vs at-risk. Please prioritize the three upsell targets: Juno Analytics (RDW-2345), Acme Corp (renewal), and Juno's procurement path.

Deliverables (for my consolidation):
- One-pager (1 slide) per account: 3–4 sentences + 2 bullets (Risk, Required Exec Help).
- Updated forecast_grid_RDW-2345_v3.xlsx with source of truth numbers in the green column.
- Flags for anything that needs leadership escalation (credits, pricing exceptions, legal hold-ups).

Deadlines: initial drafts by Tue EOD (13 Sep), final by Thu noon (16 Sep) for slide build.

I attached the previous one-pager template and the base forecast grid to update. Use the Drive link for the canonical workbook.

Thanks — keep it tight.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman | Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0191

Attachments: QBR_account_one-pager_Juno.pdf (template), forecast_grid_RDW-2345_v3.xlsx (workbook)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Sep 2027 08:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 QBR prep: compact runway notes + account-by-account asks

Naomi —

Attached are my account bullets for the three prioritized deals. Quick highlights:

Juno Analytics (RDW-2345)
- One-paragraph summary: Juno is in POC -> pilot conversion; ML platform team is pleased with latency gains; legal is finalizing data processing addendum.
- Risk: Procurement asked for a 90-day data retention policy that conflicts with our default 30d KVS.
- Required Exec Help: CTO-level signoff on retention exception + optionally 10% introductory credit to cover initial cost.

Acme Corp (Renewal)
- One-paragraph summary: Strong usage growth but seat consolidation is planned; renewal at risk if price-per-token increase is applied.
- Risk: finance wants to rebid on price banding.
- Required Exec Help: Proposal for a 12-month grandfathered rate OR a time-limited usage discount.

Forecast numbers added in green column of forecast_grid_RDW-2345_v3.xlsx — row-level notes included.

Ben
Ben Carter | Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachments: forecast_grid_RDW-2345_v3.xlsx (updated with Ben's inputs)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 14 Sep 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 QBR prep: compact runway notes + account-by-account asks

Adding a few tactical items from AE perspective —

Juno Analytics
- Customer timeline: pilot completes 9/24, decision window 9/27–10/04.
- Procurement point: Ari Thomsen (cc below) is the buyer; they route commercial through an external procurement email (procurement@acme.com) for enterprise purchases.
- Negotiable: initial term length and data-retention SLA.

Acme Corp
- Renewal target: 10/01. Owner for renewal motion is Laura.
- They want a clause for predictable unit cost if they increase spend >20% MoM.

Ask: For Juno, we should propose a short, conditional credit (5–10%) tied to successful pilot metrics, not a blanket discount. If legal needs longer retention, we should scope a limited-data subset and propose HSM/KMS controls.

Marissa
Marissa Cole | Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Quoted above: Ben's grid edits.

Attachments: none

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Sep 2027 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 QBR prep: compact runway notes + account-by-account asks

Attached is a condensed rollup for the exec slide: top-line ARR impact, committed vs best-case, and the three high-risk asks. I linked the canonical workbook here: https://drive.re/redwood/QBR/forecast_grid_RDW-2345_v3.

Summary table (excerpt):
- Committed ARR (3 deals): $1.1M
- Best-case (including expected upsells): $1.6M
- Identified risks: Juno retention SLA, Acme pricing rebid, one legal hold for Juno DPA.

Suggested exec asks: CTO signoff for retention exception (Juno); temporary credit authorization up to 10% for pilot conversions (sales-led approval); renewal grandfathering authority for renewals under $250k.

Grace O'Connor | Director, Sales Strategy, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

Attachments: QBR_exec_rollup_v1.pdf (condensed table)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Ari Thomsen <ari@junoanalytics.com>, sales@junoanalytics.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Sep 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Q3 QBR prep: compact runway notes + account-by-account asks

Ari —

Thanks again for the pilot momentum. Sharing a short internal summary of where we are and a couple asks that would help speed decisioning on your side. Ben and Marissa copied.

Quick status (for your review):
- Pilot signals are strong: latency and inference cost improvements met the SLOs we agreed on.
- Procurement request surfaced a 90-day retention preference — our standard offering is 30 days for KV cache. We can scope a limited-data retention bucket for compliant customers, or propose an HSM-backed retention exception for the pilot phase.
- As a commercial option, we can offer a conditional 7% credit for pilot-to-paid conversion (applied to month 1–3 consumption) if the pilot passes the agreed success metrics.

Could you confirm: (1) whether procurement will accept a scoped retention exception (subset of datasets), and (2) whether your legal team can sign a short-term DPA with the HSM addendum by 9/24?

If it's helpful, I'd be glad to schedule a 30-min CTO-3 joint call with our CTO and your engineering lead next week to resolve the retention ask.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this in time for the QBR.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman | Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0191

Attachments referenced: QBR_account_one-pager_Juno.pdf

From: Ari Thomsen <ari@junoanalytics.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com, sales@junoanalytics.com
Date: Sun, 19 Sep 2027 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 QBR prep: compact runway notes + account-by-account asks

Naomi —

Appreciate the concise summary. Quick responses: procurement will accept a scoped retention exception provided we get the HSM controls in writing; legal aims to have a short-form DPA back to you by 9/23 (we'll try to accelerate). The credit proposal looks reasonable internally — I will confirm numbers by EOD Monday.

Ari Thomsen
Head of Infrastructure, Juno Analytics
ari@junoanalytics.com
